name: Annotation Sync
description: Import WeChat Reading highlights and NeoReader annotation exports so the desktop agent can use them as context. Quotes are matched fuzzily; a different edition stays readable even when it cannot be anchored.
author: ReadAware

helperText.default: Create a key at https://weread.qq.com/r/weread-skills. It looks like wrk-… and is stored in this plugin's encrypted secret store. Then open Annotation Sync to sync one book.

translations.zh-Hans: 在 https://weread.qq.com/r/weread-skills 创建密钥，形如 wrk-…，只保存在本插件的加密密钥库。然后打开 Annotation Sync 同步一本书。
translations.zh-Hant: 在 https://weread.qq.com/r/weread-skills 建立金鑰，形如 wrk-…，只保存在本外掛的加密金鑰庫。然後開啟 Annotation Sync 同步一本書。
